d: Friends, have you seen this picture? These are railway stations in India. Did you and I ever think 10 years ago that one day railway stations in India will look like airports? But now all of this is possible, and this development won't be limited to just one or two railway stations. Instead, it will encompass all 1300 railway stations in the country, which will be developed under the Amrit Bharat initiative. We've mentioned this in our videos before.
